dataset_or_resource: GGDC Historical National Accounts / Comparative Historical National Accounts
coverage: Selected country series across Europe, USA, Asia and Latin America; overlapping records from 1800/1815 through 2005; World Agriculture 1800-1938; All Countries overview ca.1870-2005
dimensions: GDP at current and constant prices; agriculture, mining, manufacturing and industry output breakdown
license_or_reuse: Official datahub specifies attribution to Smits, Woltjer & Ma (2009), GD-107; no explicit reuse licence found on the official datahub page inspected
recommended_use: Supplementary sectoral-output and agricultural-production discovery/benchmark candidate for 1836-1936, subject to rights clearance and per-series provenance audit
caveat: Coverage is heterogeneous and not a uniform global panel; selected listed country series are concentrated in Europe, USA and parts of Asia/Latin America; no licence/redistribution permission inferred from downloadable links
